عَقْرَبَةٌ : see عَقْرَبٌ, first sentence. ―
-b2- Also (assumed tropical:) An iron thing like the كُلَّاب [or flesh-hook], which is suspended, or attached, to the horse's saddle. (O, K.) ―
-b3- And, of a sandal, (assumed tropical:) The knots of the [thong, or strap, called] شِرَاك [q. v.]. (TA.) ―
-b4- And, (O, K,) thus in all the copies of the K, and in the handwriting of Ibn-Mektoom, but in the L ↓ عَقْرَب , (TA,) (assumed tropical:) An intelligent female slave, who does much service, or work. (O, L, K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
